limitations.quote: I’ll update each binary pointer and its Gray-code copy on the same accepted operation
limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the zero write increment but removed the original Gray-pointer register delay, changing when `wfull` and `rempty` assert; it also added reset gating and new depth-handling logic that the one-line fix did not require.
The scoreboard used the DUT’s own flags to define accepted transfers and checked queue behavior rather than the expected cycle-by-cycle flag timing, so it passed despite the timing changes.

limitations.quote: Before changing flag arithmetic or wraparound, check whether the first request from empty reaches both consumers
limitations.note: The agent read the relevant FIFO note, but its advice to trace the first write before changing flag arithmetic or wraparound did not guide the repair.

limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the shell to reject the entire test invocation before simulation, forcing the agent to resubmit it with different cleanup logic.
